items.briefing:
Online scams continue to be a growing concern for Australians, with research highlighting the sheer volume of fraudulent websites and blogs being used to deceive everyday users. Staff should remain cautious when clicking links in emails or on social media, particularly those promoting deals, prizes, or urgent requests.

On a positive note, AI tools are increasingly being used to help organisations identify and fix security vulnerabilities faster. OpenAI has also launched a new Chat History feature in ChatGPT for macOS — if you use this tool for work, be mindful of what information you share in conversations. **Tip:** Avoid entering sensitive work or personal data into AI chat tools unless your organisation has approved them for that use.

featured.title: Australia & New Zealand face surge in critical flaws
featured.quote: Australia facing critical vulnerability crisis with widespread patch backlogs leaving organisations dangerously exposed.
